### OpenRegister reliance

**medium**: this component relies on OpenRegister for part of what it does. 2 direct references, 8 files reached through imports.

See the [reliance overview](./index.md#openregister-reliance) for the filterable list.

| `content`   | `union`                               |          | `\{\}`  | The widget's persisted configuration blob. - `scope` — whose relationship to list: `assigned` (default), `pooled`, `watched` or `all`. Whose INBOX it is stays the endpoint's decision; scope never names another user. - `limit` — rows to request AND show (1–50, default 6). The count line always states the server total regardless of this cap. - `pollSeconds` — refetch interval (default 30; `0` disables). - `rowRoute` — vue-router route NAME to open on a row click, receiving the task uuid as `:id`. Omitted = the click opens the task's openregister deep link instead. - `emptyText` — override for the empty-inbox line. - `variant` — `list` draws a checkbox list: a checkbox that completes the viewer's own task, the title, the subject on a second muted line and the due date at its right. Default: the compact rows. - `viewAllRoute` / `viewAllLabel` — a "View all" text link in the card header: a route name or location `{ name, params?, query? }`, and its label (default "View all"). `headerLink` works too. - `objectUuid` — the tasks on one record (`"@objectId"` reads the page's record), every assignee's, instead of the viewer's inbox. - `includeDone` — also list finished tasks (after the open ones). - `variant: 'table'` — the record's task table (board DqZaakTaken): task, handler, deadline, status and the row's verbs, with the summary ("1 open, 3 done · sorted by deadline") and a "New task" action in the card header. - `create` — offer "New task": `true`, or `{ appId?, label? }`; the task is posted as an open task on `objectUuid`. - `completeAny` — offer Complete on every open row, not only the viewer's own (the server still decides); `cancel` — offer Cancel. |
